name: prereg_v1
_comment: Frozen analysis parameters for PREREGISTRATION.md. Every value that could otherwise become a researcher degree of freedom lives here and is echoed by run_id. Do not edit after the prereg-v1 git tag.

decimation._comment: Thin until the mean per-channel autocorrelation falls below the threshold. TwoNN assumes i.i.d. samples and temporal correlation biases it DOWN, i.e. towards a spurious 6. On a synthetic S6 rotation of true dimension 6, hand-picked factors 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 give 4.05 / 4.49 / 5.40 / 6.01, so the analyst's choice alone would decide the verdict. The factor must come from the data.

intrinsic_dimension._comment: Acceptance windows are half-open [t-tol, t+tol) so no value belongs to two intervals and none is left unclassified (audit v2, F7). min_samples is set from the measured false-refutation rate of a TRUE S6: 36.5% at n=250, 17.5% at n=500, 14.0% at n=1000, 2.5% at n=1500, 1.0% at n=2000 (200 seeds per point). TwoNN converges to d from BELOW, so small n refutes a correct hypothesis.

geometry._comment: Absolute goodness-of-fit cutoff, calibrated in docs/09. Winning the ranking is not sufficient: rank_candidates always names a winner.

contrast._comment: Subsampling WITHOUT replacement. A with-replacement bootstrap is invalid for a k-NN estimator (audit v2, F1).
